DI G Republic of the Philippines DEPARTMENT OF THE INTERIOR AND LOCAL GOVERNMENT DILG-NAPOLCOM Center, EDSA comer Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City http: //wmrw.dilg.corn.ph DILG OPINION No. 141 s. 2022 November 7, 2022 HON. HADJI LACSON M. LANTUD Vice Mayor Municipality of Pantao Ragat Province of Lanao del Norte Dear Vice Mayor Lantud: This pertains to your letter dated 17 August 2022 addressed to Regional Director Arnel M. Agabe, which was forwarded to the Central Office for guidance regarding the peculiar circumstance surrounding the vacancy in the sangguniang bayan in your Municipality. Per your representation, during the filing of certificate of candidacy for Local Election last October I to 8, 2021 , there were only eight (8) candidates who filed their certificates of candidacy for sangguniang bayan in the Municipality of Pantao Ragat, Lanao del Norte. Unfortunately, on 16 February 2022, one of the candidates, Musa Gute passed away. Per the Commission on Elections ruling, the deceased candidate can be substituted, provided, the surname is the same with the one who are going to substitute the deceased candidate. There was no valid substitution on the death of Musa Gute as there was no willing individual to take his stead, as a consequence, there were only seven (7) candidate for sangguniang bayan members in Pantao Ragat, which eventually assumed office on the noon of June 30, 2022, leaving one (1) sangguniang bayan position unfilled. Hence, the request for guidance on the procedure in filling up the vacancy to complete the local legislative body of the said Municipality. Foremost, while the Department agrees that there is indeed a vacancy in one of the seats of the sangguniang bayan, the peculiarity of the circumstance by which said vacancy arose, unfortunately, does not find application in the provisions of the Local Government Code of 1991 (LGC). Sections 44 and 45 of the LGC are hereby quoted, which is pertinent to the discussion, viz: "SECTION 44. xxx Xxx For purposes of this Chapter, a permanent vacancy arises when an elective local official fills a higher vacant office, refuses to assume office, fails to qualify, Page | 1

dies, is removed from office, voluntarily resigns, or is othenvise permanently incapacitated to discharge the functions of his office. For purposes of succession as provided in this Chapter, ranking in the sanggunian shall be determined on the basis of the proportion of votes obtained by each winning candidate to the total number of registered voters in each district in the immediately preceding local election. SECTION 45. Permanent Vacancies in the Sanggunian. — (a) Permanent vacancies in the sanggunian where automatic succession provided above do not apply shall be filled by appointment in the following manner: (1) The President, through the Executive Secretary, in the case of the sangguniang panlalawigan and the sangguniang panlungsod of highly urbanized cities and independent component cities; (2) The govemor, in the case of the sangguniang panlungsod of component cities and the sangguniang bayan; (3) The city or municipal mayor, in the case of sangguniang barangay, upon recommendation of the sangguniang barangay concerned. (b) Except for the sangguniang barangay, only the nominee of the political party under which the sanggunian member concerned had been elected and whose elevation to the position next higher in rank created the last vacancy in the sanggunian shall be appointed in the manner hereinabove provided. The appointee shall come from the same political party as that of the sanggunian member who caused the vacancy and shall serve the unexpired term of the vacant office. In the appointment herein mentioned, a nomination and a certificate of membership of the appointee from the highest official of the political party concemed are conditions sine qua non, and any appointment without such nomination and certification shall be null and void ab initio and shall be a ground for administrative action against the official responsible therefor. (c) In case the permanent vacancy is caused by a sanggunian member who does not belong to any political party, the local chief executive shall, upon recommendation of the sanggunian concerned, appoint a qualified person to fill the vacancy. (d) In case of vacancy in the representation of the youth and the barangay in the sanggunian, said vacancy shall be filled automatically by the official next in rank of the organization concerned. " As stated in Section 44, there are specific instances by which permanent vacancy may arise in order for Section 45 to be applicable. With this, we regret to opine that the circumstance surrounding your concern does not fall on any of the enumeration under Section 44, as afore quoted. Hence, the procedure of filling-in permanent vacancies in the Sangguniang Bayan of Pantao Ragat under Section 45 is not applicable. As a matter of fact, the Department in its Legal Opinion No. 24, s. 2016, has explained that: "xxx proclamation would only mean that he acquired a plurality of the votes lawfully cast sufficient to elect him to the said position. The fact of having plurality of votes lawfully cast is what confers the title to the office xxx" 7 nfR

In your query, candidate Gute passed away before the election and was not validly substituted, and therefore. was not elected into office. more so. proclaimed to the position as one of the members of the sangguntang bayan With these premises, we cannot apply by analogy the rule on permanent vacancy under Section 45 of the LGC since the circumstance by which yout query arose does not fall within those enumerated therein, Nevertheless, we are of the view that this may be an instance by which the President may exercise his appointing power, an extraordinary power but a legal remedy, pursuant to Section 16. Article VII of the 1987 Philippine Constitution, viz "Section 16. xxx He shall also appoint all other officers of the Government whose appointments are not otherwise provided for by law. " This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion that will be rendered by more competent authorities and the courts. We hope to have assisted you accordingly. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AU H RITY OFT SECRETARY: . JUAN VICTOR R. LLAMAS n rsecretary for External, Legal and Legislative Affairs py furnish: DIR. WILHELM M.
